standards.name: MAGE-TAB
standards.abstract: MAGE-TAB is a simple spreadsheet-based format for describing microarray investigations. It represents experiments (samples, extracts, labeled extracts, hybridizations, arrays, and data files) as tab-delimited files and supports delivery of raw and processed array data (e.g., CEL files and derived matrix files). The format was developed and published by the FGED (formerly MGED) community and described in Rayner et al. (2006) to provide a MIAME-supportive, easy-to-use alternative to the XML-based MAGE-ML, enabling bench biologists to annotate, exchange and submit microarray data using common spreadsheet software. The specification defines distinct file types (IDF, ADF, SDRF, and Raw/Processed data representations) and explicitly uses the Investigation Design Graph (IDG), a directed acyclic graph, to represent relationships between materials, arrays and data objects.

classification.rationale: The MAGE-TAB source material defines concrete, named tab-delimited files with explicit column headers and data types (e.g., SDRF, ADF, IDF, ArrayData) and includes many example tables (headers and example rows). It also explicitly defines and uses an Investigation Design Graph (IDG), a DAG describing relationships between samples, arrays and data objects. Therefore the standard legitimately contains both table-level field definitions and a DAG model.

Investigation.Title.name: Investigation title
Investigation.Title.descr: Name/title of the investigation (IDF field providing general information about the investigation).
Investigation.Title.evidence: Investigation Description Format (IDF) – a tab-delimited file providing general information about the investigation, including its name, a brief description, the investigator's contact details, bibliographic references, and free text descriptions of the protocols used in the investigation.
